results.name: Thailand
results.key_finding: Why it matters: the border-war evidence that flagged Thailand was mis-dated by a year. The fighting that killed at least 38 people and displaced about 300,000 happened in July 2025, and the real July 2026 evidence — four UNHCR-recognised Chinese refugees held under pressure from Beijing — fits the existing developing-band score.

results.name: Cambodia
results.key_finding: Why it matters: the same mis-dated border war flagged Cambodia. Its genuine in-window record is still severe, with Human Rights Watch finding that civil society can now barely operate and that fewer than one in five identified scam compounds was investigated.

results.name: Pakistan
results.key_finding: Why it matters: Operation Shaban is the same pattern the critical-band score already describes, at higher intensity. Pakistan reported 129 militants killed between 5 and 16 July 2026, and Baloch groups say some of the dead were previously disappeared civilians.

results.name: Best Buy
results.key_finding: Why it matters: the layoff that flagged Best Buy happened in July 2025, not July 2026. No material harm evidence exists inside the window, so the established-band score holds.

results.name: South Korea
results.key_finding: Why it matters: South Korea gained and gave back on labour rights in the same year. The Yellow Envelope Law extended union rights to subcontractors in March 2026, then the President narrowed the scope of lawful disputes on 21 July 2026.

results.name: Barbados
results.key_finding: Why it matters: Barbados answered an exploitation allegation with law. The Protection of Wages Bill, debated 21-22 July 2026, makes payday a legal obligation and bans retention deductions and interest on salary advances.

results.name: Kansas City
results.key_finding: Why it matters: the detentions were carried out by federal agents, not by the city. Kansas City itself joined a federal amicus brief with 38 local governments and passed a five-year moratorium on non-municipal detention facilities.

results.name: Delta Air Lines
results.key_finding: Why it matters: the $8.1 million False Claims Act settlement that flagged Delta was announced in July 2025, not 2026. No material in-window evidence was found, so the established-band score holds.

results.name: Ukraine
results.key_finding: Why it matters: the July 2026 casualties are harm inflicted on Ukraine by Russian strikes, so they do not lower Ukraine’s score. Ukraine did open its own investigation into whether officials properly assessed the risk of the event that was struck.

results.name: Iran
results.key_finding: Why it matters: Iran executed five political prisoners between 16 and 22 July 2026, close to one a day. That confirms rather than changes a score already near the bottom of the scale.

results.name: Russia
results.key_finding: Why it matters: Russia is already at the absolute floor of 0 out of 100. Its 24 July 2026 strike that killed 10 people at a Kyiv-region event confirms the floor but cannot push the score lower.

results.name: Tunisia
results.key_finding: Why it matters: an 85-year-old political prisoner fainted at Mornaguia prison on 23 July 2026, where the reported temperature was 52 degrees Celsius. This worsens conditions for prisoners the score already counted rather than adding a new category of harm.

results.name: Bangladesh
results.key_finding: Why it matters: Bangladesh is rolling back the safeguards that earned it a score increase in June 2026, and the score is now close to a downgrade. HRW documented the first enforced disappearance since the 2024 uprising and the lapse of the anti-disappearance ordinances.

results.name: Ecuador
results.key_finding: Why it matters: an investigation based on 62 interviews documents torture, airstrikes on homes and drone attacks on fishing boats by Ecuadorian forces, with no prosecutions. The published 35.9 was an un-revised seed value that the May 2026 baseline had already queued for re-evaluation.

results.name: Waymo
results.key_finding: Why it matters: Waymo said it had fixed a safety problem and the problem kept happening. Dozens of vehicles stalled in San Francisco on 4 July 2026, and NHTSA gave operators until the end of July to fix emergency-responder detection.

notes: RECOVERY RUN. The 2026-07-24 nightly pipeline completed the scanner stage and died during the assessor stage. This run back-fills the assessor stage only, executed 2026-07-25 using assessment_date 2026-07-24. No digest, no briefings, no index writes, no proposal applications. ORPHANED PARTIAL OUTPUT DISCARDED. Five subdimension sidecars dated 2026-07-24 (bangladesh, iran, pakistan, russia, ukraine) survived the crash with no parent .md report. They were treated as untrusted and overwritten. Spot-check confirmed iran-2026-07-24.subdims.json carried evidence quotes byte-identical to the 2026-07-23 assessment, indicating carry-forward rather than fresh assessment. Every subdimension in this run traces to evidence gathered in this run. EVIDENCE-DATE CONTAMINATION IN THE SCAN. The scan systematically shifted 2025 events into 2026, affecting at least five entities. (1) thailand and cambodia: the scanner cited a 24 July border war with at least 38 killed, 200 wounded, about 300,000 displaced, and a 28 July Malaysia-mediated ceasefire, sourced only to the Wikipedia 2026-in-Asia page. Those are July 2025 events. HRW World Report 2026 (Cambodia chapter) states verbatim: "Fighting in July 2025 killed and injured civilians, including children, displaced around 300,000 people, and damaged religious and cultural sites." A second round of fighting occurred in December 2025 (at least 101 killed, second ceasefire 27 December 2025, 18 Cambodian soldiers released 31 December 2025). No primary source reports any Thailand-Cambodia armed clash between 2026-07-10 and 2026-07-24. The scanner 28 July dates are also in the future relative to both the scan date and the run date. Both entities were re-scored on genuine in-window evidence instead. (2) best-buy: the 161-person Best Buy Health layoff notice was filed 11 July 2025; the Healthcare Dive publication date was verified by direct fetch. (3) delta-air-lines: the $8.1 million DOJ False Claims Act settlement was announced July 2025 (Aviation A2Z 16 July 2025, Claims Journal 22 July 2025). (4) ukraine and russia: the scanner cited July as the highest monthly civilian-casualty month since 2022 at 1,674 casualties and 286 killed; that is the July 2025 UN figure. The correct in-window UN figure (HRMMU, 14 July 2026) is June 2026 as the deadliest month since April 2022, with 293 killed and 1,990 injured, and H1 2026 at 1,396 killed and 7,978 injured, up 37 percent year on year. RECOMMENDATION TO SCANNER OWNER. Sources whose URL carries no date, such as Wikipedia year-in-review pages and undated publisher slugs, are the common factor in every contaminated item. Entities flagged solely on such sources should be date-verified before they reach the assessor. DATE DISCIPLINE. No evidence dated after 2026-07-24 was scored for any entity. Background sources older than the 2026-07-10 to 2026-07-24 window are used only for standing structural context and are labelled with their true dates. CHANGE PROPOSALS. One proposal was generated: ecuador, downgrade, -10.3 points, no band crossing (developing to developing). It cleared all anti-false-positive screening checks. The published 35.9 is an un-revised bulk-import seed value with no entry in APPLIED_CHANGES.md. The 2026-05-06 first agent baseline confirmed it as a boundary case and explicitly queued a 60-day re-evaluation on structural torture and extrajudicial-killing proceedings; the HRW report of 21 July 2026 is exactly that evidence. Directionality matches: negative evidence produced a downgrade. Peer placement was checked so Ecuador sits above Tunisia at 23.8 and well below Poland at 42.2, rather than being pushed toward collapsed-state territory. WATCH FLAGS. Two near-threshold confirmations carry watch flags for the next cycle: bangladesh at -4.8 (anti-disappearance ordinances allowed to lapse; the replacement bill would bar the national human rights commission from investigating security forces) and waymo at -4.6 (the NHTSA end-of-July 2026 deadline outcome falls outside the window). ATTRIBUTION RULE APPLIED. ukraine, iran and russia were confirmed because harm inflicted on an entity by another actor does not lower that entity’s score, and floor entities cannot move lower. kansas-city was confirmed on the same rule: the detentions were federal conduct, while the city’s own conduct ran counter to it. MATH HYGIENE. Canonical reconstruction (computeCompositeFromDimensions, methodology v1.2) reproduced every published composite exactly for all 15 entities. No math-hygiene issues found. ROTATION STATE. research/rotation-state.json was updated for last_assessed, last_scanned and last_evidence_touch only. composite, band and rank were left at published values per the integrity rule; last_change_proposal was set only for ecuador. One pre-existing drift was corrected to the published value: pakistan rank 153 to 154.
